risks.title: Payment Processing Dependency
risks.score_rationale: The company generates a significant portion of its revenue through payments, making it vulnerable to market fluctuations and changes in consumer spending habits.

risks.title: Heightened Competition
risks.score_rationale: The payments and financial services market is highly competitive, which may result in market share and revenue loss.

risks.title: Credit Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company offers lending and credit services, exposing it to credit risk and potential losses.

risks.title: Regulatory and Compliance Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company must comply with strict regulations in the payments and financial services sector, which can be costly and complex.

risks.title: Technology Dependency
risks.score_rationale: The company relies heavily on technology for its operations, making it vulnerable to security and system availability risks.

risks.title: Reputation Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company may be affected by reputation issues if it fails to maintain customer and stakeholder trust.

risks.title: Liquidity Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company must manage its cash flows to finance operations and investments, which may be a risk if it fails to maintain sufficient liquidity levels.
